name: A Pet's Place Animal Hospital
description:
Full-service veterinary care offering wellness, dentistry,
diagnostics, pain management, acupuncture and urgent care
during regular office hours.

name: Absolute Vinyl Records & Stereo
description: A downtown specialty shop for new and vintage vinyl, 45s and stereo equipment, serving collectors and newer vinyl listeners from its Main Street storefront.

name: Adorn Home & Gift Gallery
description:
A longtime downtown gift shop filled with home décor, jewelry,
                accessories and unusual gifts. Adorn is a good place to browse
                when you know you need a gift but don't yet know exactly what
                you're looking for.

name: Agricultural Heritage Center
description:
Explore Boulder County's agricultural history while
seeing seasonal farm animals including chickens, pigs,
horses and goats.

name: Amazon Flex
description:
Deliver Amazon packages using your own vehicle
where local openings are available.

name: Ambrosia Glass Art
description: A Longmont glassblowing studio creating fine glass art and custom work while offering private lessons, two-person workshops and group glassblowing experiences for a range of skill levels.

name: Aspen Moon Farm
description:
A USDA Certified Organic Longmont farm
growing vegetables, herbs, flowers
and starter plants using biodynamic practices.

The seasonal roadside stand makes it easy
to shop directly from the farm.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Aspen Moon Farm

name: Atomic Goblin Games
description:
An independent game shop and gathering place for board games,
              trading cards, tabletop miniatures and scheduled community play.

name: Barbed Wire Books
description:
An independently owned downtown bookstore selling new and used
                books. Browse Colorado and local-interest titles, hard-to-find
                books, maps and guides, plus work from local authors and
                craftspeople.

name: Boulder County Jobs
description:
Boulder County employs people across human services,
administration, public works, parks, justice,
community services and many other fields.

gallery.alt: Outdoor portrait by Boulder County Photography
gallery.caption: Original portrait photography by Boulder County Photography.

name: Bowen Bakery
description: A Longmont home micro-bakery offering porch pickups, bake stands and custom batches of cookies, cupcakes, muffins, scones, cinnamon rolls, sourdough, cakes and other baked goods.

name: Bricks on Main
description: A downtown destination bringing together locally made products, food, drinks and live entertainment.

name: Butterscotch Studios
description: A locally owned creative space offering music lessons, arts programming and community collaboration.

name: Cheese Importers
description:
One of Longmont's true destination specialty stores. Wander
                through a huge selection of international and local cheeses,
                charcuterie, olive oils, spices and specialty foods, then
                explore imported textiles, kitchen goods, soaps, gifts and
                European market finds.

name: City of Longmont Careers
description:
Search employment opportunities directly with the City
of Longmont, including jobs in utilities, parks,
recreation, public safety, library services, administration
and many other departments.

name: Colorado Horse Rescue
description:
Colorado Horse Rescue has been helping at-risk horses since
1986. The organization provides rehabilitation, adoption,
foster support and education while helping horses transition
into safe homes.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Colorado Horse Rescue

name: Colorado Reptile Humane Society
description:
This Longmont-area nonprofit specializes in reptiles and
amphibians, providing sheltering, adoption, education and
care guidance for animals with highly specialized needs.
CoRHS also rehabilitates Colorado-native reptiles and amphibians,
helping wildlife in need of specialized care.

name: Composition Shop
description: A community-based independent bookstore in downtown Longmont pairing books with stationery, paper goods and chocolate, plus a busy calendar of book clubs and author events.

name: Connecting Colorado
description:
Colorado's official public workforce job system.
Create or upload a résumé, search jobs, explore career
paths, discover training and receive job-match information.

gallery.alt: Workforce Colorado — Connecting Colorado logo

name: Cottage Kennels Farm
description:
A smaller Longmont boarding facility offering overnight
dog boarding, calmer day lodging and grooming with an
emphasis on individualized routines.

gallery.alt: A woman sitting on a bench with six dogs around her outside.

name: Crackpots Pottery Studio
description: A longtime downtown Longmont creative studio where visitors can paint pottery and make art in a relaxed, all-ages setting. Crackpots also hosts parties, group gatherings and creative events.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Crackpots Pottery Studio

name: Creative Treasures
description: A local arts-and-crafts shop combining handmade consignment from Colorado creators with affordable secondhand craft supplies and a classroom for creative gatherings and classes.

name: Cultivate
description:
A nonprofit helping older adults
remain independent and connected
through volunteer-powered services
such as grocery help,
minor home repairs,
yard work,
snow shoveling
and medical rides.

gallery.alt: Photograph collage showing a senior volunteer helping in the yard, walking down a street and helping with grocery shopping

name: Dee-O-Gee Longmont
description:
A pet boutique offering specialty foods, supplements,
grooming, self-wash facilities and dog daycamp in
Downtown Longmont.

name: Dickens Farm Nature Area
description:
St. Vrain Creek runs directly through this 52-acre nature area.
              Explore the nature playground, beginner bike-skills trail,
              slower-moving water areas and St. Vrain Greenway.

name: DirtLabs Suspension
description: An independent specialist in mountain-bike suspension service, repair and tuning, with local and mail-in service.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of DirtLabs Suspension

name: DoorDash
description: Flexible restaurant and retail delivery.

name: Drifters
description: A downtown vintage clothing shop and cocktail bar offering curated secondhand finds, fresh-juice cocktails, live entertainment and private events.

name: E8YOGA
description:
A locally owned Longmont studio
with heated and non-heated yoga,
meditation,
yoga nidra,
sound experiences
and community events.

gallery.alt: Yoga practice in E8’s cedar-lined studio; photo from its official website

name: Family Pet Hospital
description:
Family Pet Hospital focuses on dogs and cats and emphasizes
a low-stress approach designed to reduce anxiety during
veterinary visits.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Family Pet Hospital

name: Firehouse Art Center
description:
Longmont’s nonprofit contemporary art center presents rotating
              exhibitions, education programs and community events in the
              Creative District.

gallery.alt: A film festival gathering at Firehouse Art Center; photo from its official website

name: Four Paws & Co.
description:
A locally owned pet store specializing in natural dog and cat
foods, raw and fresh diets, treats, supplements, toys, beds,
collars and other pet supplies.

name: Full Circle Yoga
description:
A community-focused downtown yoga studio
offering a variety of practices
including yoga, meditation,
restorative classes
and specialty programming.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Full Circle Yoga

name: Garden Acres Community Park
description:
A neighborhood sports hub with a batting cage, lighted softball
              fields, soccer space, cricket pitch, playgrounds, paths and public
              art.

gallery.alt: A tree-lined sidewalk cuts between two fenced sports fields at Longmont's Garden Acres Park.
Garden Acres Community Park in Longmont

name: Golden Loaves
description: A Longmont home bakery specializing in small-batch artisan breads, from classic boules and focaccia to flavored loaves, babka and banana bread.

name: Golden Ponds Nature Area
description:
Four ponds, mountain views, wildlife and 2.6 miles of trails make
              Golden Ponds one of Longmont's easiest places to spend a peaceful
              Colorado afternoon.

gallery.alt: Golden Ponds Nature Area in Longmont Colorado

name: Good Life Refuge
description:
A Longmont nonprofit sanctuary providing a safe forever home
for rescued farm animals. Good Life Refuge cares for over 60
animals and relies on volunteers and donors to support their
residents.

name: Greenwood Wildlife Rehabilitation Center
description:
Greenwood rehabilitates orphaned, injured and sick wild
birds, mammals and waterfowl from across the Front Range.
Call before attempting to rescue or transport wildlife.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Greenwood Wildlife Rehabilitation Center

name: Heart of Longmont
description:
A longstanding United Methodist congregation
with worship, study groups,
community events,
service projects
and meditation programming.

name: Historic Hoverhome
description:
The 1913–14 home of Charles Lewis Hover and Katherine Baird
                Hover anchors a preserved historic district connected to one of
                Longmont’s influential early families.

gallery.alt: Historic Hoverhome

name: Hover Farmstead
description:
The remaining farm buildings preserve the working side of the
                Hover family property and help tell Longmont’s agricultural
                story beyond the walls of Hoverhome.

name: Instacart
description: Shop for and deliver grocery orders.

name: Juniper Goods
description:
A women-owned lifestyle boutique built around small, independent
                and maker-led brands. Browse apparel, home goods, jewelry,
                ceramics and pantry items, including products from Colorado
                makers. There's also coffee, brunch and a zero-proof bar.

name: LifeBridge Christian Church
description:
A local Christian congregation
offering Sunday worship,
children's programming,
student ministry
and opportunities to connect
through community groups and service.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of LifeBridge Christian Church

name: Lobos Cocina & Bar
description: A locally operated Mexican restaurant with traditional dishes, steaks, seafood, cocktails and a family-friendly sports-viewing atmosphere.

name: LoCo Skateshop
description: Founded in Longmont by local skaters, LoCo carries skateboard and longboard gear, clothing and accessories while serving as a community hub for skaters throughout Boulder County.

gallery.alt: New Arrivals

name: Longmont Animal Control
description:
Longmont Animal Control handles domestic animal concerns,
certain wildlife calls, pet licensing, animal bites,
lost-animal issues and animal-related ordinance enforcement.

name: Longmont Area Chamber of Commerce
description:
The Chamber's online member system includes a job-postings
section where Longmont-area businesses can advertise
open positions.

name: Longmont Baseball League Cages
description:
The nonprofit Longmont Baseball League rents two indoor cages with
              an Iron Mike pitching machine, hitting nets, tees and practice
              balls.

name: Longmont Bicycle Company
description: A locally owned, family-run full-service bicycle shop founded in 2017, with bikes and e-bikes for many riding styles plus cycling gear, repairs and maintenance.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Longmont Bicycle Company

name: Longmont Buddhist Temple
description:
A small Jodo Shinshu Buddhist community
welcoming newcomers,
longtime practitioners
and anyone interested in learning more about Buddhism.

name: Longmont Climbing Collective
description:
Try indoor climbing, bouldering, fitness or yoga. Programs are
              available for adults and children, making it a great year-round
              activity.

name: Longmont Economic Development Partnership
description:
Longmont EDP promotes employment and economic opportunities
within Longmont and provides resources for people interested
in working for local companies.

name: Longmont Food Rescue
description:
A local nonprofit reducing food waste
while getting fresh food directly
to people who can use it.

Programs include no-cost groceries,
free produce distributions,
community fridges
and Fresh Food Connect.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Longmont Food Rescue

name: Longmont Humane Society
description:
Longmont's primary nonprofit animal shelter provides adoption,
lost-and-found services, pet rehoming resources, dog training,
veterinary care, fostering, volunteering and humane education.

name: Longmont Humane Veterinary Clinic
description:
The Humane Society's veterinary clinic provides
community veterinary services for dogs and cats
at the shelter on Nelson Road.

name: Longmont Ice Pavilion
description:
The open-air covered rink at Roosevelt Park offers public skating,
              hockey and lessons during the winter season.

gallery.alt: Ice skating in Longmont Colorado

name: Longmont Indian Kitchen
description: Chef Sheel Joshi brings modern Indian cuisine inspired by traditional flavors and refined culinary techniques to an intimate downtown dining room.

name: Longmont Meals on Wheels
description:
A local nonprofit delivering
hot meals and a daily wellness check
to older adults
and people with disabilities
in Longmont and Niwot.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Longmont Meals on Wheels

name: Longmont Museum
description:
Explore exhibitions about Longmont's history, art and culture and
              enjoy performances, films, talks, classes and special community
              events.

gallery.alt: Longmont Museum

name: Longmont Public Library
description:
More than books.

The Longmont Library offers
free programs for children, teens and adults,
classes,
digital resources,
community events,
volunteer opportunities
and spaces to learn and connect.

name: Longmont Recreation Center
description:
Swim, climb, play basketball or work out under one roof. The
              center includes lap and leisure pools, waterslides, a lazy river,
              climbing wall, gymnasium and fitness areas.

name: Longmont Senior Center
description:
A local gathering place for adults 55+
with more than 200 programs each quarter,
including classes,
fitness,
technology help,
social activities,
support services
and volunteer opportunities.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Longmont Senior Center

name: Longmont Small Animal Hospital
description:
A locally owned and female-led veterinary hospital providing
preventive care, dentistry, surgery, urgent care, diagnostics
and care for some exotic pets.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Longmont Small Animal Hospital

name: Longmont Yarn Shoppe
description: An independent, woman-owned yarn shop with knitting and crochet supplies, fiber-arts tools and hands-on classes.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Longmont Yarn Shoppe

name: Lyft
description: Flexible rideshare driving where available.

name: Magic Fairy Candles
description:
Much more than a candle shop. Magic Fairy Candles carries
                handmade candles, aromatherapy, crystals, incense, natural
                perfumes, ritual items, apothecary goods and plenty of
                unexpected finds.

name: Maker General
description:
A general store built specifically for makers. Maker General
                specializes in thoughtfully selected textile and fiber supplies,
                handmade goods and creative materials. They also host sewing,
                mending and maker workshops.

gallery.alt: Maker General Harriet Tubman Embroidery Kit

name: McIntosh Lake Nature Area
description:
Enjoy Longs Peak views while walking around the lake, fishing,
              kayaking, canoeing or paddleboarding. It's one of Longmont's
              favorite sunset spots.

gallery.alt: A view of Longmont's McIntosh Lake recreation area, with Long's Peak in the background.

name: Mile-Hi Skydiving Center
description:
For a completely different view of Longmont, take to the sky.
              Mile-Hi offers tandem skydives for first-timers as well as
              training for experienced jumpers.

name: MKT Visibility
description:
Helping Colorado small businesses stay visible without having to
                do all of the marketing themselves. MKT Visibility provides
                social media management, content creation, photography and
                video, website support, Google Business Profile support, and
                digital marketing services tailored to small businesses.

name: NewCastle Comics & Games
description: A local specialty shop for comic books, tabletop games, trading cards and collectibles.

name: Obra Arts
description: Artist Joyanna Rose Gittings welcomes visitors to a working studio and gallery offering handmade art and creative learning in English and Spanish.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Obra Arts

name: Old Mill Park
description:
A small downtown historic park where relocated pioneer-era
                buildings, gardens and artifacts create an approachable window
                into early life in the St. Vrain Valley.

gallery.alt: Old Mill Park

name: Old St. Stephen’s Church
description:
Built in 1881 and long known as the “Little White Church,” this
                downtown landmark is among Longmont’s oldest surviving church
                buildings and now serves community and preservation uses.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Old St. Stephen’s Church

name: Olde Towne Animal Medical Center
description:
A full-service veterinary practice providing preventive
care and medical services from puppy and kitten care
through senior-pet wellness.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Olde Towne Animal Medical Center

name: Ollin Farms
description:
A family-run regenerative farm
growing vegetables and building community
around food, healthy soil and education.

The farm offers a seasonal farm stand,
CSA shares, youth education,
farm tours and farm-to-table dinners.

gallery.alt: Family

name: Open Window Studio
description: Explore art and clay through classes, workshops and camps for children, teens and adults in a creative studio on a Longmont family farm.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Open Window Studio

name: OUR Center
description:
A Longmont nonprofit resource center
providing groceries, meals
and other support to individuals
and families working toward stability
and self-sufficiency.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of OUR Center

name: Paw Au Pair
description:
Longmont-based professional in-home pet sitting and dog
walking for dogs, cats, puppies, special-needs pets,
birds and fish.

gallery.alt: Pet Sitter Longmont CO

name: Quarter’s Bar + Arcade
description: A locally founded downtown arcade with classic games, pinball, self-serve drinks and private party options.

name: Recovery Café Longmont
description:
A community-centered recovery organization
creating a welcoming space
for people rebuilding their lives.

Volunteer opportunities include cooking,
hospitality,
teaching classes
and helping with support activities.

name: Retail Therapy Vendor Market
description: An indoor multi-vendor market featuring independent sellers, vintage finds and handmade goods.

name: Robin Chocolates
description: A Longmont chocolate kitchen making bonbons, truffles, bars and seasonal confections with artistic designs and distinctive flavors.

name: Rocky Mountain Kennels
description:
Longmont-area dog boarding and doggie daycare with
climate-controlled kennels and outdoor exercise areas.

gallery.alt: Dogs with a handler at Rocky Mountain Kennels; photo from its official gallery

name: Rocky Mountain Pumpkin Ranch
description: A local seasonal farm destination known for its fall pumpkin activities and family outings.

gallery.alt: Assorted colorful gourds and Indian corn on straw

name: Rover
description: Pet sitting, dog walking and boarding.

name: Sandstone Ranch Visitors & Learning Center
description:
Explore a historic homestead first settled in 1860. Inside you'll
              find hands-on history and environmental exhibits, while outside
              trails pass historic buildings, sandstone bluffs and wildlife
              habitat.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Sandstone Ranch Visitors & Learning Center
Sandstone Ranch in Longmont Colorado

name: Scoops on the Corner
description: A locally owned neighborhood ice cream shop serving handcrafted ice cream made with Colorado dairy, plus milkshakes, sundaes and other sweet treats.

name: Shoes & Brews
description: A distinctly Longmont combination of specialty running store and taproom, pairing running shoes and gear with community runs, local beer and a social gathering place for runners and walkers.

name: Simply Bulk Market
description: A downtown bulk market where shoppers can refill their own containers with foods, spices, teas, personal-care products, cleaning supplies and other goods while reducing packaging waste.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Simply Bulk Market

name: SNOW Apparel
description: An independent downtown women's boutique focused on slow fashion, with clothing and accessories selected around quality, ethical production and sustainable materials.

name: SOUL 19
description:
A Longmont mindful-movement studio
combining yoga,
strength,
barre,
breathwork
and meditation.

The studio emphasizes connection,
growth and shared experience.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of SOUL 19

name: St. John the Baptist Catholic Church
description:
A longstanding Longmont Catholic parish
with English and Spanish services,
religious education,
community ministries
and its own community food bank.

gallery.alt: St. John the Baptist Catholic Church

name: St. John the Baptist Food Bank
description:
A volunteer-supported Longmont food bank
providing food boxes to local individuals
and families experiencing difficult times.

gallery.alt: St. John the Baptist Food Bank

name: Sunflower Farm
description:
Farmfest visitors can meet goats, sheep, cows, horses,
llamas, chickens and other farm animals while exploring
play areas, tractors, hay bales and the working farm.

gallery.alt: Sunflower Farm

name: Table of Hope Food Pantry
description:
A volunteer-run nonprofit food pantry
operating from White Fields Community Church.

The pantry provides food assistance
and welcomes community volunteers
to help with distribution and operations.

name: Taskrabbit
description: Earn money completing local household and handyman tasks.

name: The Bee Hugger Farm
description:
A welcoming six-acre Longmont farm where visitors can meet and
                feed animals, explore vintage farm features, shop for local
                honey and enjoy seasonal experiences such as U-pick sunflowers,
                a pumpkin patch, pony rides, hayrides, Christmas trees and
                special events. Check the farm’s website or social pages for
                current hours, seasonal activities and group requirements before
                visiting.

name: The Blackbird House
description: A downtown shop for unusual gifts, crystals and metaphysical finds.

name: The Canvas Local Art Bar
description: A locally owned downtown art studio combining guided painting experiences with an on-site bar featuring Colorado-made drinks and snacks. The Canvas offers classes, open painting and private events.

name: The Flower Bin
description:
A family-owned Longmont garden center operating since 1971, with
                five acres of plants, indoor growing space, gardening supplies,
                gifts and home décor.

gallery.alt: Legendary Flower Bin-Grown Hanging Baskets

name: The Quill & Candle Bookshop
description: A cozy independent bookshop in Prospect New Town with curated fiction and children's books, book-themed gifts and community events including author visits and book clubs.

name: The ROUND PANTRY
description:
A community food distribution
hosted by Westview Presbyterian Church.

Shoppers receive prepacked groceries
including pantry foods
and fresh items when available.

No qualification or ID is required.

gallery.alt: Allen DSC_0011c3.JPG

name: TinkerMill
description:
A volunteer-powered nonprofit makerspace with woodworking,
              welding, pottery, textiles, robotics, laser cutting, blacksmithing
              and more.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of TinkerMill

name: Tumbleweed Art Collective
description:
Part boutique, part gallery and part creative community.
                Tumbleweed features handmade art and goods created by local
                artists and makers, including work for the home and garden. It's
                the kind of place where the inventory changes depending on what
                local artists are creating.

name: Twin Peaks Pet Care
description:
A locally owned pet-care company serving Longmont and
surrounding Boulder County communities with in-home pet
care, dog walking, pet sitting and training.

name: Uber
description: Passenger rides and delivery opportunities.

name: Union Reservoir Nature Area
description:
This 736-acre body of water offers boating, fishing, kayaking,
              paddleboarding, picnicking and a dedicated dog beach.

name: Upwork
description:
Freelance online projects including admin, writing,
design, marketing and technical work.

name: Valley Veterinary Hospital
description:
A full-service small-animal hospital providing medical,
surgical, dental, diagnostic and wellness care for dogs
and cats.

gallery.alt: Woman holding dog in forest

name: Wax Crescent
description: Shop small-batch candles and curated artisan goods, or join a candle-making class focused on blending your own fragrance.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Wax Crescent

name: Wells Athletics Batting Cages
description:
A locally owned, year-round indoor baseball facility with batting
              cages, pitching machines and space for individual or team
              practice.

name: Westview Presbyterian Church
description:
A Longmont Presbyterian congregation
with worship, study groups,
fellowship activities
and extensive community service
through The ROUND PANTRY.

gallery.alt: Photo from the official website of Westview Presbyterian Church

name: Wheelhouse
description: A community pottery studio in Prospect New Town focused on adult ceramics education and independent studio practice, with multi-week classes, private events and memberships for experienced potters.

name: Whispering Pines Pet Resort
description:
A country-style Longmont pet-care facility offering
dog boarding, daycare, cat boarding, grooming and training.

gallery.alt: golden retriever and lab mix dogs at whispering pines pet resort daycare

name: Wolf & Wren
description: A downtown shop for letterpress greeting cards, stationery, notebooks, writing tools and thoughtfully curated gifts.

name: Workforce Boulder County
description:
Workforce Boulder County is one of the most useful
employment resources available to Longmont residents.
Their Longmont office welcomes walk-ins and can help
with much more than simply finding job postings.

name: Wren’s Nest Art Studio
description: Art classes, camps, open studio sessions and creative gatherings for children and adults.

gallery.alt: Wren's Nest Art Studio

name: YA YA Farm & Orchard
description:
A small historic orchard specializing
in heirloom apples and family-oriented
farm experiences.

Visitors can shop the farm stand,
see the farm animals,
bring a picnic
and enjoy seasonal events.

gallery.alt: YA YA Farm & Orchard

name: Longmont Farmers Market
description: Local farmers, ranchers, food producers and artisans gather at the Boulder County Fairgrounds.
